columns.t: Optional toppings: Nutella; fruit (bananas, strawberries, etc); sugar
Mix in a bowl until the batter does not have many lumps.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat, then coat the hot pan with a thin layer of butter. A pan with low sides works best.
Pour in 1/3 cup batter and tilt to spread. Cook about 40 seconds per side, transfer to a plate, re-butter the pan, and repeat.
Add your desired toppings and roll up the crepes.
